verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted web app (Docker, npm, Helm). Its custom-endpoint docs explicitly name Ollama as a provider configured via librechat.yaml and support any OpenAI API-compatible service, which covers local servers that expose such an API. An older community comment said it made no effort to support local models, and another pointed to a LiteLLM proxy workaround; both appear outdated given the current first-party Ollama custom-endpoint documentation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of llama.cpp, LM Studio and vLLM; evidence that a fully offline deployment has no cloud dependency for features like RAG and code execution; independent hands-on confirmation of local-only operation.
